question.text: The US also occupied this country after the Spanish-American War, though they did not annex it. The CIA tried to use an exploding cigar and a tuberculosis-infected scuba suit to kill Fidel Castro, a Communist who led this country during the Cold War.

question.text: The book Cultures of the Lusophone Black Atlantic discusses Aguda people whose Nago ancestors were repatriated to Benin and Nigeria after this 1835 revolt led by enslaved Yoruba Muslims in Salvador da Bahia ("BAH-ee-uh"), Brazil.
question.answerHtml: Malê revolt [or Revolta dos Malês; or Imale Revolt; prompt on Great Revolt or Grande Revolta]
question.clue: This 1835 revolt of enslaved African Muslims in the city of Salvador da Bahia. Most of the participants in the revolt were Yoruban Nagos.

question.leadin: Answer these questions about a ruler whose control of the Dominican Republic was known as the "Platano Curtain."
question.text: This man was elected president in 1930 when a rebellion toppled Horacio Vasquez's government. He later banned all other political parties, renamed Santo Domingo, the province of San Cristobal, and the country's highest mountain after himself. He also oppressed Haitians in his country.
question.clue: He also ordered the killings of the Mirabal Sisters, and the failure of general Pupo Roman to act following this man's death allowed Johnny Abbes Garcia to catch and punish most of his assassins.
